title: A mailbox message reported deliveredToIdleSession did not wake the idle session for about 47 minutes
outcome: A message whose send receipt says deliveredToIdleSession starts a turn in that idle session promptly, or the host records why it did not and keeps the wake pending.
acceptance: A mailbox message reported deliveredToIdleSession did not wake the idle session for about 47 minutes is done
disposal_reason: Not a defect: a misreading by the reporter. Engram::Fable (TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #804, 04:35Z) confirms that the '1735' it cited was the senderProcessedThrough field of its own send receipt for #1737, which is its cursor as the sender, not Opus's. Engram::Opus processed #1736 in a turn at 03:45Z (mailbox 587a65fb #165). No missed wake was observed. Cancelled by Termal::Fable2 (coordinator).
